key_idea: Reduce f modulo a full turn 2r; the waffle ends blueberry-up iff the angle is within 90 degrees of 0, i.e. x<r/2 or x>3r/2.
sketch: Let x = f mod 2r, which is the position within one full 360-degree rotation. The pan snaps to the nearest horizontal, so blueberries are up iff the angle is in [0,90) or (270,360), i.e. 2x<r or 2x>3r in integers; otherwise down. O(1). Use integer comparisons (doubling) to avoid floating point; the exact vertical case is excluded by the statement.
